description: ocsp.rs line 102: when the caller-supplied issuer cert's subject DN does not match cert.tbs_certificate.issuer, the code returns Err(OcspSignatureInvalid). This is a misleading error: the signature was never attempted — the mismatch is a caller contract violation (wrong issuer cert supplied), not a signature problem. The same pattern appears in check_revocation_against_anchor at line 228. Callers looking at OcspSignatureInvalid will diagnose this as a key/signature problem rather than a cert-issuer mismatch, making debugging harder. Suggested fix: return Err(Error::OcspCertIdMismatch) or introduce a dedicated Err(Error::OcspIssuerMismatch) variant. At minimum update the doc comment to explain that this error is also returned for caller-side issuer identity mismatches.
title: P1: check_revocation issuer mismatch returns OcspSignatureInvalid
